blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agent memory benchmarks evaluate whether an agent's responses reflect correct knowledge, measuring downstream question-answering accuracy as a proxy for memory quality. We show this evaluation paradigm is incomplete: it conflates memory correctness with retrieval and generation quality, producing both false positives where correct responses mask broken memory and false negatives where incorrect responses blame correct memory for retrieval failures. We introduce FEB-30, a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories spanning 6 diagnostic categories and 3 difficulty levels, constructed via paradigm inversion: documents are generated from known fact trajectories, yielding deterministic ground truth without human annotation. Each trajectory defines how a fact should evolve across multi-author artifacts (documents, emails, conversations), enabling direct inspection of the memory store after each ingestion step. Applying FEB-30 to a representative memory system, we demonstrate that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence thresholds. Diagnostic decomposition reveals that the system correctly classifies memory operations (create, update, reinforce, supersede) only 20% of the time, a failure entirely invisible to extrinsic evaluation, and that failure modes differ systematically by category and difficulty. We release the benchmark, document generation pipeline, and scoring framework to support reproducible evaluation of agent memory systems.
blocks.zh: 代理内存基准评价一个代理的答复是否反映了正确的知识,测量下游的问答准确性作为内存质量的代用. 我们显示这个评价范式是不完整的:它将内存的正确性与检索和生成质量混为一谈,产生假阳性,正确反应掩盖了内存被破坏,而错误反应则将正确的内存归咎于检索失败. 我们提出FEB-30,这是30个事实演进轨迹的基准,涵盖6个诊断类别和3个难度级,通过范式倒置构建:文件由已知的事实轨迹产生,在没有人类注释的情况下产生决定性的基础真理. 每一轨迹都界定了一个事实如何在多作者文物(文件、电子邮件、对话)之间演变,从而能够在每一摄取步骤之后直接检查内存储存。 将FEB-30应用于代表性记忆系统,我们表明,内在和外在的评价平均相差16个百分点,44%的轨迹超过了有意义的相差阈值。 诊断分解显示系统对内存操作(创建,更新,强化,取代)的正确分类只有20%的时间,这是外部评价完全看不见的失败,失败模式因类别和难度而有系统差异. 我们发布了基准、文件生成管道和评分框架,以支持对代理存储系统进行可复制的评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) agents operating over extended time horizons require persistent external memory to accumulate knowledge beyond the ephemeral context window ( Sumers et al. 2024 ; Jiang et al. 2026 ) . As these systems grow more complex, with over a dozen distinct architectures published since 2023 ( Latimer et al. 2026 ; Packer et al. 2024 ; Rasmussen et al. 2025 ; Chhikara et al. 2025 ; Zhu et al. 2026 ) , the question of how to evaluate them becomes pressing.
blocks.zh: 在较长时间范围内运行的大型语言模型(LLM)剂需要持续的外部内存来积累电子上下文窗口以外的知识(Sumers等人. 2024; 蒋等 2026). 随着这些系统日益复杂,自2023年以来出版了十多套独特的建筑(Latimer et al. 2026; Packer et al. 2024; 拉斯穆森等人著. 2025; Chhikara等人著. 2025; 朱等 2026),如何评价这些问题变得紧迫.

blocks.en: A survey of current benchmarks reveals a systematic limitation: every existing evaluation measures memory quality extrinsically , by posing questions to the agent and grading its responses ( Maharana et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2026 ; Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026 ; Uddin et al. 2026 ; Liu and Yadav 2026 ; Jung et al. 2026 ) . This produces a single composite score that conflates memory, retrieval, and generation quality. When the system fails, one cannot identify which component is responsible; when it succeeds, one cannot confirm the memory is actually correct ( Toma and Matei 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 对现行基准的调查表明存在系统性的局限性:现有的每一项评价都通过向代理商提出问题和对其答复进行分级来外部衡量记忆质量(Maharana等人,2001年)。 2024; Wu et al. 2026; Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026; Uddin et al. 2026; 刘和亚达夫 2026; 郑等 2026. 由此产生一个单一的复合分数,将内存,检索,生成质量压缩. 当系统失败时,无法识别哪个组件负责;当成功时,无法确认内存实际上是正确的(Toma和Matei 2026).

blocks.en: We identify two concrete failure modes that extrinsic evaluation cannot detect:
blocks.zh: 我们发现两种外部评价无法发现的具体故障模式:

blocks.en: • False positives (LLM compensation): A strong generation model can produce correct responses despite incorrect or incomplete memory state, by reasoning over partial retrieval results at inference time. Extrinsic evaluation scores this as success. • False negatives (retrieval bottleneck): A memory system may correctly store and update facts, yet fail to retrieve them for a specific query due to embedding mismatch or retrieval cutoff. Extrinsic evaluation blames the memory system for a retrieval failure.
blocks.zh: • 支助 假阳性(LLM补偿): 尽管内存状态不正确或不完整,强生成模型仍可以通过推论时间对部分检索结果进行推理来产生正确的响应. 极端评价将这评为成功。 • 支助 假负( 检索瓶颈) : 一个内存系统可能正确存储和更新事实,但由于嵌入错配或检索截断,无法为特定查询检索. extrinsic评价将内存系统归咎于检索失败.

blocks.en:
We propose intrinsic evaluation , direct comparison of the memory store contents against known ground truth at each stage of knowledge evolution, as a complementary evaluation paradigm. The relationship mirrors unit versus end-to-end testing in software engineering: intrinsic evaluation checks the memory component’s internal state directly, while extrinsic evaluation only observes end-to-end behavior, so a passing end-to-end test can mask a broken component just as a correct component can fail end-to-end due to an integration bottleneck. A parallel from NLP history motivates the same shift: in the 2010s, word embeddings were evaluated only through downstream task performance until intrinsic evaluation (analogy tasks, similarity correlations) enabled faster progress by isolating representation quality ( Baroni, Dinu, and Kruszewski 2014 ; Schnabel et al. 2015 ) .
Our contributions are: 1. FEB-30 , a benchmark of 30 fact-evolution trajectories with deterministic ground truth, spanning 6 diagnostic categories that isolate distinct failure modes invisible to extrinsic evaluation. The benchmark comprises: • Fact-evolution trajectories with atomic claim ground truth at each state. • A paradigm-inversion document generation pipeline using multi-model rotation and 3-judge verification. • A scoring framework measuring both intrinsic (claim coverage, update detection, false update rate) and extrinsic (QA accuracy) metrics. 2. Intrinsic evaluation methodology for agent memory: direct inspection of memory state against known ground truth at each stage of knowledge evolution, enabling diagnostic decomposition of failures by pipeline stage. 3. Empirical evidence that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by 16 percentage points on average , with 44% of trajectories exceeding meaningful divergence and failure modes differing systematically by category.
blocks.zh:
我们建议进行内在评价,将记忆库的内容与知识演进的每个阶段已知的地面真相直接进行比较,作为补充评价范式。 关系镜的单位相对于软件工程中的端对端测试:内在评价直接检查内存组件的内部状态,而外部评价只观察端对端的行为,因此通过端对端的测试可以掩盖一个断裂的组件,就像一个正确的组件会因为整合瓶颈而失败. 与NLP历史类似,也激发了同样的转变:在2010年代,单词嵌入只通过下游任务性能来评价,直到内在评价(分析任务,相似性相关)通过隔离表达质量(Baroni, Dinu, 和 Kruszewski 2014; Schnabel et al. 2015)得以更快的进展.
我们的贡献是: 1. FEB-30, 由30个事实演化轨迹构成的基准,具有决定性的地面真伪,涵盖6个诊断类别,这些类别隔离了无法外在评价的明显失败模式。 基准包括: 事实演进轨迹,每个州都有原子主张的真相。 • 支助 采用多模式旋转和3名裁判核查的范式反转文件生成管道。 衡量内在(索赔范围、更新检测、假更新率)和外部(质量保证准确度)计量标准的评分框架。 2. 物剂内存的内在评价方法:在知识演化的每个阶段,根据已知的地面真相,直接检查内存状态,从而能够通过管道阶段对故障进行诊断分解. 3. 有经验证据表明,内在评价和外在评价平均有16个百分点的差异,44%的轨迹超过了有意义的差异和故障模式,按类别有系统差异。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: MemoryAgentBench ( Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026 ) defines four memory competencies (retention, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and information integration) evaluated through QA interactions. Memora ( Uddin et al. 2026 ) introduces the FAMA metric that penalizes reliance on invalidated memories, decomposing performance into freshness-aware components. LongMemEval-V2 ( Wu et al. 2026 ) tests long-term memory along five temporal reasoning capabilities. AMA-Bench ( Zhao et al. 2026 ) evaluates long-horizon memory for agentic applications. STATE-Bench ( Liu and Yadav 2026 ) measures whether agents improve at tasks through accumulated experience. MEME ( Jung et al. 2026 ) introduces controlled state trajectories with multi-entity evolution, the closest methodology to ours, though still evaluated through the response layer.
blocks.zh: MemoryAgent Bench (Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026)定义了通过QA互动评价的四种内存能力(保留,时间推理,知识更新,以及信息整合). Memora(Uddin等人,2026年)引入了FAMA的度量衡,它惩罚依赖无效记忆,将性能分解为新知元件. LongMemEval-V2(Wu等人,2026年)以5种时间推理能力测试长期记忆. AMA-Bench (Zhao et al. 2026)评价了用于代理应用的长视距内存. 国家-本奇(刘和亚达夫 2026年)通过积累的经验衡量代理人在执行任务时是否有所改进. MEME(Jung等人,2026年)引入了具有多实体演化的受控状态轨迹,这是与我们最接近的方法,尽管仍然通过反应层进行评估.

blocks.en: All these benchmarks share a common structure: pose queries to the agent, grade responses against expected answers. None directly inspects the memory store.
blocks.zh: 所有这些基准都有一个共同的结构:向代理人提出询问,对预期答复作出分级答复。 没有人直接检查记忆库.

blocks.en: Recent surveys ( Jiang et al. 2026 ; Du 2026 ; Luo et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2025 ; Huang et al. 2026 ) catalog memory architectures and operations. Du et al. ( Du et al. 2025 ) define six core memory operations (consolidation, updating, indexing, forgetting, retrieval, condensation), decisions that should be evaluated at the operation level, not only through downstream responses. The Anatomy of Agentic Memory survey ( Jiang et al. 2026 ) identifies benchmark saturation as a key concern, yet proposes more extrinsic benchmarks as the solution.
blocks.zh: 近期调查(Jiang等人,2026年;Du 2026年;Luo等人). 2026; 胡等编. 2025; Huang et al. 2026)目录记忆建筑与操作. 杜等编. (Du et al. 2025)定义了6个核心内存操作(整合,更新,索引,遗忘,检索,压缩),决定应该在操作层面进行评估,而不仅仅是通过下游的响应. 物剂记忆的解剖学调查(Jiang等人,2026年)将基准饱和确定为一个关键问题,然而却提出了更多的外延基准作为解决方案.

blocks.en: ConflictBank ( Su et al. 2024 ) benchmarks LLM behavior under knowledge conflicts but evaluates at query time, not at the memory consolidation stage. MAGIC ( Lee, Lee, and Kim 2025 ) tests multi-hop conflict detection in retrieval-augmented generation. These address a related but distinct problem: they test whether a model can reason about conflicts in retrieved context, not whether a memory system correctly detects and resolves conflicts during ingestion.
blocks.zh: ConflictBank(Su et al. 2024)在知识冲突下将LLM行为作为基准,但在查询时进行评价,而不是在内存整合阶段. MAGIC(Lee,Lee,和Kim 2025)在检索-增强生成中测试多跳冲突检测. 这些都解决了一个相关但截然不同的问题:它们测试一个模型是否能够在检索到的上下文中解释冲突,而不是一个内存系统在摄入时是否正确检测和解决了冲突.

blocks.en: RIKER ( Roig 2025 ) introduced the concept of generating evaluation corpora from known ground truth for RAG evaluation, avoiding the expense and subjectivity of human annotation on real documents. We extend this approach to temporal fact evolution, generating multi-document sequences where ground truth is a trajectory of states rather than a static set of facts.
blocks.zh: RIKER(Roig 2025)提出了从已知的地面真相产生评价公司的概念,用于RAG评价,避免了人类对真实文件的注释的成本和主观性. 我们把这种方法扩大到时间事实演变,产生多文件序列,其中地面真理是国家的轨迹,而不是一套静态的事实。

blocks.en: The distinction between intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation is well-established in NLP for embeddings ( Baroni, Dinu, and Kruszewski 2014 ; Schnabel et al. 2015 ) and parsing. The Future AGI practitioner framework ( Future AGI 2026 ) explicitly argues that direct memory store inspection is an anti-pattern. A concurrent survey ( Toma and Matei 2026 ) documents this gap systematically across 15 benchmarks, arguing for complementary intrinsic evaluation. We present the first benchmark and empirical results that validate this argument.
blocks.zh: NLP对嵌入物(Baroni、Dinu和Kruszewski,2014年;Schnabel等人,2015年)和剖析法的内在评价和外在评价的区别是明确的。 未来AGI实践者框架(Future AGI 2026 )明确认为,直接记忆库检查是一种反模式检查. 同时进行的一次调查(Toma和Matei,2026年)系统地记录了15个基准的这一差距,认为需要补充内在评价。 我们提出第一个基准和经验结果来证实这一论点。

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark Design: FEB-30
blocks.zh: 3 基准设计:FEB-30

blocks.en: FEB-30 (Fact Evolution Benchmark, 30 trajectories) is organized along diagnostic categories and difficulty levels (Section 3.4 ). The name is a deliberate analogy: February 30 is a date that does not exist, the calendar approaches it asymptotically (February 28, sometimes 29) but never reaches 30. Similarly, recent benchmarks and surveys have moved progressively closer to intrinsic evaluation, introducing memory-specific tasks ( Hu, Wang, and McAuley 2026 ) , decomposing scores into memory-aware components ( Uddin et al. 2026 ) , and defining controlled state trajectories ( Jung et al. 2026 ) , yet remain on the extrinsic side of the threshold, never directly inspecting the memory store, as illustrated by ( Toma and Matei 2026 ) . FEB-30 crosses it.
blocks.zh: FEB-30(实际演化基准,30个轨迹)按诊断类别和难度水平排列(第3.4节)。 这个名字是有意的类比: 2月30日是一个不存在的日期,日历以不对称的方式接近它(2月28日,有时29日),但从未达到30. 同样,最近的基准和调查也逐渐接近内在评价,引入了内存特定的任务(胡,王,麦考利2026),将分数分解为内存感元件(Uddin等人2026),并定义了可控状态轨迹(郑等人2026),然而仍然停留在阈值的外侧,从不直接检查内存存储,如(Toma和Matei2026)所示. FEB-30横跨.

blocks.en: 3.1 Diagnostic Categories
blocks.zh: 3.1 诊断类别

blocks.en: Each category targets a specific gap in extrinsic-only evaluation (Table 1 ):
blocks.zh: 每个类别都针对外部评价中的具体差距(表1):

blocks.en: Table 1: FEB-30 diagnostic categories with design constraints. C1 and C2 are designed to produce intrinsic-extrinsic divergence; C3–C6 test dimensions where intrinsic evaluation provides richer signal than extrinsic.
blocks.zh: 表1:有设计限制的FEB-30诊断类别. C1和C2旨在产生内在-外在差异; C3-C6测试维度,其内在评价提供的信号比外在更丰富。

blocks.en: C1 (LLM Compensation) constructs scenarios where memory state is incorrect (e.g., outdated fact not updated, contradictions unresolved) but a strong LLM still produces correct answers by reasoning over retrieved fragments, so a system that never updates its facts scores well extrinsically.
blocks.zh: C1(LLM补偿)构建了内存状态不正确的情景(例如过时的事实没有更新,矛盾没有解决),但强烈的LLM仍然通过推理在被检索的碎片上产生正确的答案,因此一个从未更新其事实的系统得分非常高.

blocks.en: C2 (Retrieval Bottleneck) constructs scenarios where facts are correctly stored but queries are phrased to produce low embedding similarity (vocabulary mismatch, different abstraction level). The memory is correct, only retrieval fails.
blocks.zh: C2(Retrieval Bottleneck)构建了事实正确存储但问句以产生低嵌入相似性(vocabulary match,不同抽象级)的情景. 内存正确, 只有检索失败 。

blocks.en: C3 (Classification Accuracy) tests whether the system correctly classifies each observation as a create, update, reinforce, or conflict operation, decisions extrinsic evaluation cannot observe directly.
blocks.zh: C3(分类准确性)测试系统是否将每个观测结果正确分类为创建、更新、强化或冲突操作,外部评价决定不能直接观察。

blocks.en: C4 (Synthesis Quality) tests whether multiple observations from different artifacts merge into correct, well-formed facts, with ground truth specifying which should form a single fact versus separate facts.
blocks.zh: C4(综合质量)检验不同文物的多种观测是否合并成正确,造型良好的事实,并明确了哪些事实应构成一个单一的事实,哪些是单独的事实.

blocks.en: C5 (Temporal Correctness) tests whether the memory state correctly reflects temporal evolution: linear progression (A → \rightarrow B → \rightarrow C), retraction, and gradual drift across artifacts.
blocks.zh: C5(时间正确性)测试内存状态是否正确反映时间演化:线性进化(A →\右旋B →\右旋C),还原,并逐渐漂移到文物之间.

blocks.en: C6 (Multi-Author Attribution) tests whether source identity affects consolidation correctly: corroboration from different authors should raise confidence differently than repetition from one, and disagreement should trigger conflict detection.
blocks.zh: C6(多作者归属)测试源身份是否对合并产生正确影响:来自不同作者的证实应当提高信任度与来自一个作者的重复不同,分歧应触发冲突检测.

blocks.en: 3.2 Difficulty Levels
blocks.zh: 3.2 难度

blocks.en: Table 2: Difficulty levels in FEB-30.
blocks.zh: 表2:FEB-30的难度水平。

blocks.en: At L1 (Table 2 ), target claims appear almost verbatim in generated documents with minimal surrounding noise. At L2, claims are embedded within realistic document context and require extraction from longer passages. At L3, claims must be inferred from combinations of statements, and documents contain substantial unrelated content that could mislead extraction systems.
blocks.zh: 在L1(表2)中,目标索赔几乎逐字逐字出现在产生的文件中,周围噪音很小。 在L2中,索赔包含在现实的文件背景中,需要从较长的段落中提取。 在L3中,索赔必须从各种报表的组合中推断出来,而且文件含有大量不相关的内容,可能误导提取系统。

blocks.en: 3.3 Trajectory Schema
blocks.zh: 3.3 轨迹学

blocks.en: Each trajectory is defined as a JSON structure specifying:
blocks.zh: 每一轨迹被定义为JSON结构,具体说明:

blocks.en: • A unique trajectory ID, category, difficulty, and domain assignment. • A type indicating the evolution pattern (linear-evolution, contradiction, scope-expansion, retraction, stable, or gradual-drift). • A sequence of states , each containing a set of atomic claims representing the expected memory contents after processing documents up to that state. • Per-state docClaims , the subset of claims that the document for that state should contain (new information only, not cumulative repetition). • An expected action per state transition (create, update, reinforce, conflict, or supersede). • Author role and document type metadata for multi-author trajectories.

blocks.zh: 一系列状态,每个状态都包含一组原子性主张,在处理到该状态的文件后代表预期的内存内容.

blocks.en: Per-state docClaims , the subset of claims that the document for that state should contain (new information only, not cumulative repetition).
blocks.zh: 州文件应该包含的索赔(只有新资料,而不是累积重复)。

blocks.en: An expected action per state transition (create, update, reinforce, conflict, or supersede).
blocks.zh: 每个州过渡(创建、更新、强化、冲突或取代)的预期行动。

blocks.en: Author role and document type metadata for multi-author trajectories.
blocks.zh: 多作者轨迹的作者角色和文档类型元数据.

blocks.en: Claims are required to be atomic (one assertable proposition per claim) and self-contained (understandable without reference to other claims). This ensures scoring is unambiguous: each claim either is or is not entailed by the system’s fact store.
blocks.zh: 债权必须是原子性的(每个债权一个可断言的命题)和自成一体的(无需提及其他债权即可理解)。 这保证了打分是明确的:每个索赔要么是或不是系统的事实库引起的。

blocks.en: The key design choice is docClaims vs. claims : documents contain only new information per state. The system must retain prior knowledge across document ingestions, testing actual memory persistence, not single-document extraction.
blocks.zh: 关键设计选择是 Doc Claims vs. claims : 文件只载有每个州的新资料。 系统必须保留文档摄入的先前知识,测试实际内存持久性,而不是单文件提取.

blocks.en: 3.4 Distribution
blocks.zh: 3.4 分发

blocks.en: FEB-30 contains 30 trajectories across 6 categories, distributed across difficulty levels (10 at L1, 10 at L2, 10 at L3). Trajectories span 6 technical domains (infrastructure, security, financial operations, machine learning, data engineering, and containers) to avoid domain-specific bias. These trajectories instantiate the benchmark in a technical and business-operations setting, but the methodology is domain-agnostic as the same paradigm-inversion construction can produce trajectories for any domain in which facts evolve across multi-author artifacts, by substituting the domain’s own topics and observation categories. The total corpus comprises 147 generated documents: 127 trajectory state documents and 20 noise documents (4 per C2 trajectory to test retrieval under distraction).
blocks.zh: FEB-30包含30个轨迹,分为6个类别,分布在难度级(10个L1,10个L2,10个L3). 轨迹跨越6个技术领域(基础设施、安全、金融业务、机器学习、数据工程和容器),以避免特定领域偏差。 这些轨迹在技术和业务操作的设定中将基准即时化,但这种方法是域-不可知的,与范式-反演构建一样,可以通过取代域本身的主题和观测类别,为事实在多作者文物中演变的任何域产生轨迹。 总共包括147份生成的文件:127份轨迹状态文件和20份噪音文件(每C2轨迹4份,在分散注意力下测试检索)。

blocks.en: 4 Document Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4 文档生成管道

blocks.en: We adopt paradigm inversion ( Roig 2025 ) : rather than annotating ground truth on real documents (expensive and subjective), we generate documents from known fact trajectories, making the trajectory itself the ground truth. Algorithm 1 formalizes the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们采用范式倒置(Roig 2025):我们不是在真实文件上标注地面真相(成本和主观),而是从已知的事实轨迹中生成文件,使轨迹本身成为地面真相. 算法1使管道正规化.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Document Generation with Verification
blocks.zh: 算法 1 文档生成与验证

blocks.en: 4.1 Multi-Model Rotation
blocks.zh: 4.1 多模式旋转

blocks.en: Documents are generated using 6 models across 5 providers, rotated per state index within each trajectory to simulate different human authors with different writing styles. No single model generates more than 30% of total documents. Following evidence that multi-source synthetic data mitigates distribution collapse ( Schaffelder and Gatt 2026 ) and reduces single-generator bias ( van Elburg, van der Putten, and Marx 2025 ) , this additionally simulates the natural stylistic variation of multi-author corpora.
blocks.zh: 文件是使用5个提供者的6个模型生成的,在每个轨迹内每个州指数旋转,以模拟不同人类作者的写作风格不同. 没有单一的模型生成超过全部文件的30%. 在有证据表明多源合成数据可以缓解分布崩溃(Schafffelder and Gatt 2026),并减少单源偏差(van Elburg, van der Putten, and Marx 2025)之后,这又进一步模拟了多授权体的自然结构变异.

blocks.en: The generation models are all different from the system’s extraction model (which uses a different LLM family), avoiding the stylistic bias that inflates scores when the same model generates and extracts ( van Elburg, van der Putten, and Marx 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 生成模型都与系统的提取模型(使用不同的LLM家族)不同,避免了同一模型生成和提取时夸大分数的风格偏差(van Elburg, van der Putten, 和 Marx 2025).

blocks.en: 4.2 Style-Grounded Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 样式组合生成

blocks.en: Documents follow a realism gradient across difficulty levels:
blocks.zh: 文件在困难层次上遵循现实主义梯度:

blocks.en: 1. Style-grounded (L1/L2): An LLM generates a new document for the trajectory claims but mimics the tone, vocabulary, and structure of a real reference document. 2. Hybrid injection (L3): Claims are inserted into actual human-written documents from unrelated domains, producing text that is approximately 90% authentic.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 样式定位( L1/ L2 ) : LLM为轨迹索赔生成新文档,但模仿真实参考文档的语气,词汇和结构. 2. 混合注射(L3):索赔被插入来自无关领域的实际人文书面文件,产生约90%的正文。

blocks.en: Style-grounded (L1/L2): An LLM generates a new document for the trajectory claims but mimics the tone, vocabulary, and structure of a real reference document.
blocks.zh: 样式定位( L1/ L2 ) : LLM为轨迹索赔生成新文档,但模仿真实参考文档的语气,词汇和结构.

blocks.en: Hybrid injection (L3): Claims are inserted into actual human-written documents from unrelated domains, producing text that is approximately 90% authentic.
blocks.zh: 混合注射(L3):索赔被插入来自无关领域的实际人文书面文件,产生约90%的正文。

blocks.en: For style-grounded generation, documents are typed (meeting notes, email, architecture review, status update, executive briefing) and matched to style references from a curated set of 12 AMI meeting summaries ( Carletta et al. 2005 ) and 12 Enron emails ( Klimt and Yang 2004 ) selected for diversity in length, formality, and structure.

blocks.en: For L3 trajectories, host documents are selected from unrelated domains (e.g., product design meetings, energy pipeline discussions) to ensure no semantic overlap with the trajectory topic, making scoring unambiguous: any relevant fact the system extracts must come from the injected section.
blocks.zh: 对于L3轨迹,主机文件是从不相关的领域(如产品设计会议,能源管道讨论)中选择的,以确保与轨迹主题不发生语义重叠,使评分毫不含糊:系统提取的任何相关事实必须来自注入部分.

blocks.en: 4.3 Verification Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.3 核查管道

blocks.en: The verification criterion (Algorithm 1 , line 6) requires unanimous agreement from 3 independent judge models (different from the generators), following the multi-judge grounding methodology of ( Uddin et al. 2026 ) and ( Roig 2025 ) . Each judge assesses: (1) all target claims are inferable from the document, (2) no extra factual information beyond the trajectory is introduced, and (3) the document reads naturally.
blocks.zh: 核查标准(算法1,第6行)要求3个独立法官模型(与发电机不同)的一致同意,遵循多法官打地法(Uddin等人,2026年)和(Roig 2025年).。 每个法官评估:(1) 所有目标索赔均可从文件中推断,(2) 没有提出超出轨道的额外事实资料,(3) 文件自然阅读。

blocks.en: Additionally, documents underwent human review, with 11% requiring content corrections (forward leakage, narrative contradictions, cross-document inconsistencies, numeric mismatches) and 28% requiring scaffolding removal (code fences, LLM preamble such as “generated email about…” or “injected claims into…”) that does not affect extraction.
blocks.zh: 此外,文件经过了人文审查,11%的文件要求内容更正(前传泄漏、叙述矛盾、跨文件不一致、数字不匹配),28%的文件要求脚手架拆除(码栅栏、LLM序言,如“关于......的电子邮件”或“注入的索赔”),不影响提取。

blocks.en: To demonstrate the benchmark’s diagnostic utility, we evaluate a representative agent memory system (Figure 1 ). The system follows the dominant architectural pattern shared by virtually all contemporary memory systems, Hindsight ( Latimer et al. 2026 ) , Mem0 ( Chhikara et al. 2025 ) , AriadneMem ( Zhu et al. 2026 ) , and commercial agent memory services alike: (1) extract structured observations from artifacts (documents, emails, meeting transcripts), (2) embed them, (3) retrieve related existing facts via vector search, (4) classify the relationship via LLM (create, update, reinforce, conflict, or skip), and (5) synthesize into evolving facts with history. This extract-embed-classify-synthesize pipeline represents the current state of the art; despite surface differences in implementation details (confidence stepping in Hindsight, entropy-aware gating in AriadneMem, Add/Update/No-op in Mem0), the core information flow is shared. The specific system is not the contribution; any system implementing this pattern could be substituted. Our goal is to demonstrate what the benchmark reveals about this class of systems, not to evaluate a particular implementation.
blocks.zh: 为了证明基准的诊断效用,我们评价一个具有代表性的代理记忆系统(图1)。 该系统沿用了几乎所有当代记忆系统(Hindsight(Latimer等人,2026年)),Mem0(Chhikara等人,2025年),AriadneMem(Zhu等人,2026年),以及商业代理记忆服务所共有的主导建筑模式:(1) 从文物(文件、电子邮件、会议记录)中提取结构化的观测结果,(2) 嵌入这些记录,(3) 通过矢量搜索检索相关的现有事实,(4) 通过LLM(创建、更新、强化、冲突或跳过)对关系进行分类,(5) 将演变中的事实与历史结合起来。 这种提取-模块分类-合成管道代表了目前的状态;尽管执行细节存在表面差异(信心踏入Hindsight,Entropy-aware gating in AriadneMem,Add/Update/No-op in Mem0),但核心信息流是共享的. 具体的系统不是贡献;任何执行这种模式的系统都可以取代。 我们的目标是展示这一类系统的基准所揭示的内容,而不是评估某一项执行情况。

blocks.en: We adopt a two-layer terminology: observations are static, atomic factual statements extracted from a single artifact (typed into categories such as decisions, commitments, or milestones), while facts are the evolving, synthesized knowledge units that the system maintains over time. Observations are immutable once extracted; facts are the persistent memory that gets created, reinforced, updated, or superseded as new observations arrive. Not all observations aggregate into facts: some are too granular or transient (e.g., a one-time action item), and evaluating observations in isolation would only measure extraction completeness and atomicity, not whether the system forms and maintains correct knowledge. Other systems use different terms for similar concepts (Hindsight calls atomic extractions “facts” and synthesized summaries “observations”; Mem0 uses “memories” for both layers without distinction), but the underlying two-layer pattern, extraction followed by aggregation, is shared. Intrinsic evaluation targets the fact layer, as this is the knowledge state that determines system behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们采用两个层次的术语:观察是静态的,原子的事实陈述,取自单一的文物(类型为决定,承诺,或里程碑等类别),而事实则是系统随时间推移而保持的不断发展的,综合的知识单位. 观察一旦提取就不可改变;事实就是随着新的观察结果的到来而产生、强化、更新或取代的持续记忆。 并非所有的观测都汇总成事实:有些观测过于颗粒化或瞬间化(例如一次性行动项目),孤立地评估观测只会测量提取完整性和原子性,而不是系统是否形成和保持正确的知识. 其他系统对类似概念使用不同的术语(Hindsight称原子提取“事实”和合成摘要“观测”;Mem0不加区别地为两层使用“记忆”),但基本的两层模式,即提取之后的聚合,是共享的。 内在评价以事实层为目标,因为这是决定系统行为的知识状态.

blocks.en: Each fact maintains a numeric confidence score (0–1), strengthened by +0.1 per reinforcing observation and adjustable by the LLM on create, update, or supersede decisions. A temporal guard prevents stale observations from overwriting newer knowledge: if an observation is older than the matched fact’s last update, update and supersede decisions are automatically downgraded to reinforce. Facts track a full chronological history (statement, confidence, change type, and trigger observation at each step), enabling intrinsic evaluation to inspect the complete evolution path. The system additionally tracks the number of distinct contributing authors per fact, counting unique contributors across supporting observations, which enables C6 (multi-author) evaluation. Retrieval uses hybrid search combining BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza 2009 ) keyword matching (weight 0.3) with k-NN vector similarity (weight 0.7) over 1024-dimensional embeddings. All LLM classification and synthesis calls use temperature 0 for deterministic outputs; remaining variance across runs comes from the embedding retrieval layer. The system runs on cloud-hosted LLM APIs for both extraction and synthesis (prompts and models in Appendices B , D ).

Using a stricter pass/fail criterion ( ≥ \geq 0.5 vs. < < 0.5), in 21 ± 4 21\pm 4 % of trajectories one evaluation method passes while the other fails, meaning a practitioner relying on extrinsic evaluation alone would reach the wrong conclusion about system correctness in roughly 1 out of 5 cases (Cohen’s κ = 0.118 \kappa=0.118 , barely above chance), confirming the two evaluation methods carry largely independent signal. A Pearson correlation between intrinsic and extrinsic scores across all 330 paired evaluations is r = 0.423 r=0.423 ( p < 10 − 15 p<10^{-15} ), so r 2 ≈ 0.18 r^{2}\approx 0.18 : only 18% of the variance in one score is explained by the other, 82% independent. The signed mean divergence is + 0.118 ± 0.029 +0.118\pm 0.029 , indicating intrinsic scores are systematically higher than extrinsic: the system’s memory is on average better than what QA evaluation reveals. A Wilcoxon signed-rank test over all 330 paired trajectory evaluations ( W = 4042 W=4042 , p < 10 − 16 p<10^{-16} ) confirms this divergence is statistically significant, establishing that the two evaluation methods measure fundamentally different properties of the system. blocks.en: Table 4 reveals three co-occurring failure patterns that intensify with difficulty. First, the claim miss rate rises from 58% at L1 to 88% at L3, indicating that subtle or embedded claims are increasingly lost during extraction. Second, fact count inflates from 9.1 to 20.7, showing the system fragments knowledge into many small, partially redundant facts rather than synthesizing them into coherent evolving beliefs. Third, classification accuracy degrades from 37% to 10%, meaning the system rarely identifies the correct action (create vs. update vs. reinforce) at higher difficulty. These three signals are mutually reinforcing: poor classification leads to creating new facts instead of updating existing ones (inflating count), which in turn fragments claims across facts (increasing miss rate on claim-level matching). None of these diagnostics are available from the extrinsic QA score, which remains flat at ∼ \sim 50% regardless of the underlying failure pattern.
blocks.zh: 表4显示了三种共同发生的故障模式,这些模式在困难中加剧。 首先,索赔差错率从L1的58%上升到L3的88%,这表明在提取过程中,微妙或嵌入式索赔越来越丢失。 第二,事实夸大从9.1到20.7,显示系统将知识分散成许多小的、部分多余的事实,而不是将它们合成不断演变的一致信念。 第三,分类精度从37%下降到10%,这意味着系统很少在更高难度下识别正确的动作(创建对更新对强化). 这三个信号是相辅相成的:分类不当导致产生新的事实,而不是更新现有事实(夸大了计数),而这反过来又分散了各种事实的主张(在索赔层次的比对上,误差率上升)。 这些诊断都无法从外部的QA得分中找到,无论背后的故障模式如何,QA得分仍然平坦地保持在 \\sim 50%.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Intrinsic evaluation does not replace extrinsic evaluation, it complements it. Extrinsic captures end-to-end utility as intrinsic enables diagnosis. A system scoring high on both is genuinely effective; high extrinsic but low intrinsic signals fragility (dependent on LLM compensation); high intrinsic but low extrinsic indicates a retrieval or generation bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 体外评价不能取代体外评价,而是补充体外评价。 外感捕捉到端到端的有用性,因为内在作用可以进行诊断. 一个系统在两者上都获得很高的分数,是真正有效的;高外部但低内在信号脆弱(取决于LLM补偿);高内在但低外部表示检索或生成瓶颈。

blocks.en: Generated documents may not capture all properties of real multi-author text. We mitigate this through style grounding, multi-model rotation, and hybrid injection at L3. Future work should validate transfer via rank correlation with human-annotated real document sequences.
blocks.zh: 生成的文档可能无法捕捉真实多作者文本的所有属性. 我们通过L3的样式地面、多型旋转和混合注射来缓解这种情况。 今后的工作应通过与人附加说明的真实文件序列的等级关系来验证转让。

blocks.en: FEB-30 targets factual evolution across multi-author artifacts. It does not evaluate episodic memory, procedural memory, or single-turn conversational recall, capabilities addressed by existing benchmarks. The benchmark contains 30 trajectories, sufficient for diagnostic evaluation but not for fine-grained statistical comparisons. Scoring relies on embedding similarity thresholds and LLM judges, introducing potential measurement noise.
blocks.zh: FEB-30针对的是跨多作者文物的事实演变. 它不评估由现有基准处理的零星记忆、程序记忆或单回合对话召回的能力。 该基准包含30个轨迹,足以进行诊断性评价,但不足以进行精细的统计比较。 测算依赖于嵌入相似性阈值和LLM判断,引入潜在的测量噪声.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced FEB-30, the first benchmark designed for intrinsic evaluation of agent memory systems. By constructing trajectories where the expected memory state is known at every step, we demonstrated that intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation diverge by an average of 16 percentage points, with 44% of trajectories showing meaningful disagreement, revealing false positives and false negatives invisible to response-based benchmarks. Diagnostic decomposition showed the system correctly classifies memory operations only 20% of the time (degrading from 34% at L1 to 10% at L3), a dimension extrinsic evaluation cannot measure.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了FEB-30,这是第一个用于内在评价代理存储系统的基准. 通过构建每个步骤已知预期内存状态的轨迹,我们证明了内在和外在的评价平均相差16个百分点,44%的轨迹显示出有意义的分歧,揭示出虚假的正值和虚假的负值对基于反应的基准是看不见的。 诊断分解显示系统仅正确分类了20%的内存操作(从L1的34%降至L3的10%),一个维度外部评价无法测量.

blocks.en: We argue that intrinsic evaluation should become standard practice alongside extrinsic benchmarks, analogous to how intrinsic evaluation of embeddings complemented downstream task evaluation in NLP. We release FEB-30, the generation pipeline, and the scoring framework for reproducible evaluation of agent memory.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,内在评价应当与外在基准一起成为标准做法,类似于内在评价嵌入式评价如何补充NLP的下游任务评价。 我们释放了FEB-30, 生成管道, 和评分框架 对代理内存的可复制评价。

blocks.en: Table 7 lists all models used in the system under test and the evaluation scorer. The system uses a single frontier LLM for both observation extraction (converting artifact text into atomic observations) and fact synthesis (classifying the relationship between new observations and existing facts, then rewriting the fact statement). Titan Embeddings V2 ( Amazon Web Services 2024 ) generates 1024-dimensional vectors for semantic search. Retrieval combines BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza 2009 ) keyword matching (weight 0.3) with k-NN vector similarity (weight 0.7). The evaluation scorer uses Claude Haiku 4.5 ( Anthropic 2025 ) for judging and Amazon Nova Pro ( Amazon Artificial General Intelligence 2025 ) for answer generation. All LLM calls use temperature 0 for deterministic outputs. All models are accessed via cloud-hosted APIs.
blocks.zh: 表7列出了测试中系统使用的所有模型和评价计分器. 系统既使用单个前沿LLM进行观测提取(将文物文本转换为原子观测),又使用事实合成(分类新观测与现有事实的关系,然后重写事实陈述). Titan Embeddings V2(Amazon Web Services 2024)生成1024维向量用于语义搜索. 检索结合了BM25(Robertson and Zaragoza 2009)关键词匹配(重0.3)与k-NN矢量相似(重0.7). 评价记分员使用Claude Haiku 4.5(Anthropic 2025)来判断,亚马逊Nova Pro(Amazon 人工智能2025)来回答生成. 所有LLM调用都使用温度0来决定输出. 所有模型都通过云托管的API访问.

blocks.en: Note that fact coverage (whether the system creates any fact related to the trajectory topic) is 98.8% overall , the system almost always creates a fact. The low claim coverage reported here reflects that the created facts are incomplete or fragmented, not that they are entirely absent.

blocks.en: Trajectory length (number of states) is moderately correlated with lower intrinsic accuracy (Spearman ρ = − 0.45 \rho=-0.45 , p < 0.02 p<0.02 ): trajectories with 2–3 states average ∼ \sim 71% accuracy while those with 5–7 states average ∼ \sim 49%. This confirms that longer fact evolution sequences are harder to track, independently of the difficulty level assignment.

blocks.en: Table 9 shows update detection recall (UDR), false update rate (FUR), and confidence MAE per category and difficulty, all averaged across N = 11 N{=}11 runs.
blocks.zh: 表9显示更新检测召回(UDR),假更新率(FUR),以及每个类别和难度的信心MAE,均在N=11NQQX11运行.

blocks.en: Table 9: Update detection recall (UDR), false update rate (FUR), and confidence MAE per category and difficulty, averaged across N = 11 N{=}11 runs ( ± \pm std across runs). C2 and C5 never produce false updates but C1 and C6 frequently misclassify reinforcements as updates. Confidence calibration is worst for C6 (multi-author) and best for C4 (synthesis). FUR decreases with difficulty because at L3 the system rarely modifies facts.
blocks.zh: 表9:更新检测召回(UDR),假更新率(FUR),以及每个类别和难度的信心MAE,平均跨N=11NQQ11运行(±\pm stdd跨运行). C2和C5从未产生虚假的更新,但C1和C6经常错误地将加固归类为更新. 信心校准对于C6(多作者)最差,对于C4(合成)最差. FUR在困难中减少,因为在L3,系统很少修改事实.

blocks.en: C1 and C6 show both low UDR ( ∼ \sim 51%) and high FUR ( ∼ \sim 39%): the system misses true updates while simultaneously making false updates, a double failure that intrinsic evaluation exposes but extrinsic cannot distinguish from simple low accuracy. C2 and C5 achieve near-perfect UDR with zero false updates, indicating the classification challenge is category-specific rather than a general system weakness.
blocks.zh: C1和C6都显示低UDR(\\sim 51%)和高FUR(\\sim 39%):系统错过了真实的更新,同时进行虚假的更新,这是内在的评价暴露但外在的双重失败,无法区分简单的低精度. C2和C5在零假更新的情况下实现近乎完美的UDR,表示分类挑战是类别特定而非一般系统弱点.

blocks.en: Confidence calibration is relatively uniform across categories (range 0.092–0.124), with an overall MAE of 0.106 indicating systematic miscalibration of approximately 10 points. C6 (Multi-Author) shows the worst calibration (0.124), likely because the system does not adequately adjust confidence based on author diversity. Calibration degrades slightly with difficulty (0.089 at L1 to 0.118 at L3), consistent with the system being less certain about harder trajectories.
blocks.zh: 信任度校准在各类别之间相对一致(介于0.092-0.124之间),总体MAE为0.106,表明系统校准大约10点. C6(多作者)显示最差的校准(0.124),可能是因为系统没有根据作者的多样性充分调整信心. 校准在难度下略微降解(L1为0.089,L3为0.118),这与系统对更硬的轨迹不太确定一致.

blocks.en: Appendix G Metric Correlations
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en: To validate that our intrinsic metrics capture meaningful signal, we compute correlations between claim miss rate, intrinsic accuracy, and extrinsic accuracy across all 30 trajectories (using per-trajectory means across N = 11 N{=}11 runs).
blocks.zh: 为了证实我们的内在指标能捕捉到有意义的信号,我们计算所有30个轨迹(使用N=11 NXX11的每轨距)中声称误差率、内在准确度和外在准确度之间的关联。

blocks.en: Table 10: Pearson correlations across 30 trajectories. Miss rate strongly predicts intrinsic accuracy ( r = − 0.84 r=-0.84 ) but weakly predicts extrinsic accuracy ( r = − 0.39 r=-0.39 ), confirming that intrinsic metrics capture signal that extrinsic evaluation misses. The moderate intrinsic-extrinsic correlation ( r = 0.55 r=0.55 ) indicates the two methods share some signal but measure substantially different properties.
blocks.zh: 表10 皮尔逊在30个轨迹中的相互关系. Miss rate 强烈预测内在精度(r = − 0.84 r = - 0.84),但弱预测外在精度(r = − 0.39 r =-0.39),证实内在的度量衡捕捉到外在评价缺失的信号. 温和的内在-外在关系(r = 0.55 r = 0.55)表示这两种方法具有一些信号,但测量的特性大不相同。

blocks.en: The strong negative correlation between miss rate and intrinsic accuracy ( r = − 0.84 r=-0.84 , p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ) validates that claim coverage is the primary driver of intrinsic scores. The weaker correlation between miss rate and extrinsic accuracy ( r = − 0.39 r=-0.39 ) confirms that extrinsic evaluation is less sensitive to extraction failures , consistent with LLM compensation masking missing claims at query time. The moderate positive correlation between intrinsic and extrinsic ( r = 0.55 r=0.55 ) shows they are related but far from equivalent, reinforcing the paper’s argument that both are needed.
blocks.zh: 误差率与内在精度(r = − 0.84 r = - 0.84,p < 10 − 8 p < 10^{-8})之间强烈的负相关,验证了索赔覆盖范围是内在分数的主要驱动力. 误差率和外部精度(r = - 0.39 r = - 0.39)之间的关联性较弱,这证实外部精度评价对采掘失败不太敏感,这与LLM赔偿在查询时掩盖缺失的索赔是一致的。 内在和外在关系(r = 0.55 r = 0.55)之间的适度正相关关系表明它们相互关联,但远非同等关系,这强化了论文关于两者都需要的论点。

blocks.en: Table 11: Signed divergence (intrinsic − - extrinsic) per category. C1 shows strong positive bias by design: memory is correct but QA underestimates. C6 shows no directional bias: both metrics are equally poor at capturing multi-author attribution.
